breakdown_notes.accuracy: -1. Value carries every element of ar «يشهد مجمّع الميناء أعمال ترميم، وقد تكون بعض أجزائه مغلقة» / en «The port complex is undergoing restoration work, and some parts may be closed»: В портовом комплексе = مجمّع الميناء (mosque not named, per BRIEF), идут реставрационные работы = يشهد أعمال ترميم (progressive), некоторые его участки = بعض أجزائه («его» binds to the complex as the Arabic pronoun does), могут быть закрыты = قد تكون مغلقة. Nothing added. -1 for the label: «Текущий статус» adds a temporal specifier and drops «الموقع/Site»; harmless (the value is present-progressive) but not 1:1.
breakdown_notes.nativeness: -3. «идут реставрационные работы» is the standard Russian notice register (lighter than «ведутся»), no канцелярит; comma before «и» correct (two independent clauses, no shared secondary member: the locative does not govern the second clause, «его» re-points to it). «участки» natural for parts of a site. Deduction for slight notice-board formality of «реставрационные работы» and two-clause length for a card value.
breakdown_notes.termbase_style: -1. First-word capital only, no final period (0/41 ru card values end with a period), U+0020 only; «реставрационные работы» for ongoing works consistent with body «отреставрировали» for the completed programme.

rulings.a_mosque_itself_affected: Logged as source defect / open question, neither applied nor rejected. Writing «реставрация мечети завершена, работы идут в остальной части комплекса» would add an unconfirmed fact (fence outranks fluency).
rulings.b_label: KEEP «Текущий статус»; «Ситуация на месте» rejected; no judge edit. (1) The ru blind reader raised no observation on the label in round 2: it reads as a status notice and no longer promises an access answer (round-1 finding 2 resolved). (2) It is an existing sourced termbase entry (B12-3); the two Arabic labels name the same card function (a state-of-site notice), so one Russian label for both erases no distinction a Russian reader needs, and reuse beats minting a parallel label. (3) «Ситуация на месте» carries a news/incident register in Russian («ситуация на месте происшествия») that alarms more than the source does, and would be an unsourced new entry chosen on taste. Integration task: add «حالة الموقع»/«Site status» (uqair-mosque) as second source of the «Текущий статус» entry.
